headline: Validates the configured server URL before the repair command displays it
summary: The `hermitstash-sync repair` command now routes the configured server URL through the same URL validator the sync and WebSocket transports use before it is shown, so a malformed server entry surfaces with a clear error instead of being printed and then failing the enrollment exchange, and the command displays the normalized origin rather than the raw configuration string. Behaviour is otherwise unchanged.

items.title: Repair validates and normalizes the server URL before display
items.body: The repair command parsed nothing before echoing the configured server URL. It now validates that value through the same parser the sync and WebSocket transports apply (rejecting a non-http(s) or malformed entry up front) and prints the reconstructed origin, so the value shown to the operator is a validated, normalized URL rather than the raw configuration string.
